evidence_set: Twelve trials kept two monitors in the room with the participant for the whole session and one had four; five trials published in 2023 used a single monitor per participant. Rooms were either disguised (living-room style; decorated, pleasant or peaceful; flowers or plants) or left as the hospital environment without particular changes (4 trials); the authors judge the decision to disguise the dosing room rather than amend it to make it more pleasant to have been taken arbitrarily, without evidence-based reasoning. Table 2: a pleasant environment reported by 17 of 25 trials, a monitor present during the session by 18.

evidence_set: Only blood pressure is reported; secondary outcomes are to be published elsewhere. The authors suggest that music may be a practical, low-risk, non-drug way to improve the blood-pressure response and name the modest sample as a limitation.
